architectural_law: Every authentic disturbance is a trace of a named dream dimension, expressed by physical evidence, two independent corroborations, a reproducible interpretation and a verified site payoff.

profiles.causality: The calm, suspended rhythm of Campo Onírico Azul imprints discontinuous pressure lines into ordinary stone.
profiles.physical_origin: Natural marked_stone seam in a cave or rocky outcrop; player-placed blocks cannot become a source.
profiles.initial_sign: Two short interrupted bands of stone with coherent striation direction, not an arbitrary glowing block.
profiles.geologic_corroboration: A second rock exposure with matched angles but shifted strata; following their angle predicts a stable area of interest.

alternate_corroborations.audio: A localized absence of ambient detail compared to nearby terrain; soft enough to be optional.
alternate_corroborations.visual: Repeated directional bands, different silhouette and small non-emissive drifting particles mark the same source without audio.

interpretation.sleep: Optional non-teleport dream recall near the authentic place: a recognizable slow-falling blue-landscape silhouette.
interpretation.awake: Observe a repeatable alignment during a calm local window; same answer without sleeping or special equipment.

profiles.story_question: Why do marks in waking stone resemble the silence of an inaccessible blue landscape?
profiles.gameplay_choice: Compare geology and trace the source, or return at another condition for a memory clue; both routes lead to the same recoverable proof.
profiles.accessibility: No audio-only clue; no compulsory sleep; no color-only clue.
profiles.quality_gate: Two clues from different observations and at least one guaranteed physical site; no purely cinematic completion.

profiles.causality: Discontinuity from the fragmented Dreamscape displaces the perceived alignment of strata without creating permanent dangerous gravity.
profiles.physical_origin: Natural marked_stone layers near terrain with clear rock support; terrain validation before any scene is committed.
profiles.initial_sign: Two neighboring, physically consistent stone strata terminate at incompatible angles.
profiles.geologic_corroboration: A detached, stable, non-trap rock alignment confirms the unusual axis and encodes a local direction.

alternate_corroborations.audio: A brief directional echo which changes relative to the real fracture, never a random scare.
alternate_corroborations.visual: A repeatable shadow and fractured silhouette exposing the same alignment; usable with audio off.

interpretation.sleep: Optional fragmented horizon recall showing a recognizable Dreamscape bridge motif; it never enters the dimension.
interpretation.awake: Use the physical axis and a second anchored alignment to infer the direction without sleeping.

profiles.story_question: What pushed two parts of the same rock layer into incompatible directions?
profiles.gameplay_choice: Follow the disrupted geology or reconstruct it from a waking/dream echo; both produce a testable physical destination.
profiles.accessibility: No sudden fall, portal, teleport, combat trap or jump-scare; no compulsory sound or sleep.
profiles.quality_gate: Payoff persists across reload; false player-created traces have no progression or reward.
